reasoning: This trial failed at the most basic level - it was never activated. The protocol was designed but never implemented, meaning no patients were enrolled and no data was collected. This represents a complete failure to execute the study rather than a scientific failure of the mechanism. Without any patients enrolled or data collected, we cannot assess target engagement, pathway modulation, clinical translation, or population effects. The failure appears to be operational/commercial rather than mechanistic.
